It freezes the distinct reconstruction route, complete row boundary and exact comparison before the version-three carrier reconstruction is executed.

successful product rows versus unsuccessful substrate controls

treating a product-only characterization block as complete carrier custody
claiming that every coproduct was separately measured when it was structurally reconstructed
altering the law, row boundary, comparison or protected engine after observing the reconstruction
halt_condition: Halt if either exact equation fails, any of the thirty-two rows is omitted or reordered, a procedure is assigned the wrong reagent, an unsuccessful control is admitted as a successful elimination, or any protected byte changes.
